verdict.rationale: Atlas does have document workflows, so this axis applies: it lets you create, send, and track SAFEs from the Dashboard and view incorporation documents. However, nothing in the evidence shows configurable signing order, automatic reminders, or expirations on outstanding signature requests. Basic send-and-track capability is adjacent to this story and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can set signing order, automatic reminders, and expirations on outstanding signature requests
